name: OKC_K_REL_OBJS_H
description: This component specifies the relationship between contract header or lines to other contracts defined in ECM. The relationship between one ECM contract and another is manually specified by the user. The relationship type between the contracts will be defined in a user extensible look up code in fnd_lookups where lookup_type = ???OKC_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE???.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Primary key column.

columns.name: REL_OBJ_PUID
columns.description: Rel Obj PUID

columns.name: CHR_ID
columns.description: Id of the contract for which the relationship is defined.

columns.name: CLE_ID
columns.description: If relationship is specified for a particular contract line, is null otherwise. This is only populated for OM originated contract lines. User specified relationships are always at the contract level, and this attribute is not used.

columns.name: RTY_CODE
columns.description:
Type of relationship. For OM relationships, seeded values are provided. For user defined relationships, users can add their own relationship types.
For e.g., Ordered From (OM relationship), Referenced By (user relationship).

columns.name: JTOT_OBJECT1_CODE
columns.description:
Identifies the source of the relationship, always hard coded.
Order Header  - OKX_ORDERHEAD
Order Line ??? OKX_ORDERLINE
User defined ??? OKX_ECMCONTRACT

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT1_ID1
columns.description: Identifier1 of the related object in the source system.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
